_comment: Screenshot manifest for the CoreTend website. Source captures are real app UI on the synthetic demo dataset only (Website/SCREENSHOT_GUIDE.md, .claude/rules/site-design.md). 'approved' is true ONLY when a human has signed off THIS capture for THIS product version. Scripts/site/export-screenshots.py reads 'source' -> writes 'web1x'/'web2x'. Scripts/site/check-screenshots.py validates this file.
